summary: The user lost approximately 47000 dollars in crypto after installing malware identified as Nova Stealer while setting up Homebrew on a new MacBook. The infection occurred after the user followed a malicious link and executed an unverified installation command.
user_mistake: executed an unverified terminal command while installing software
prevention: Confirm installation commands against the softwares official documentation before execution / Reinstall the operating system after an information stealer infection
